description: Suggest up to 10 brand name ideas for what the user sells, each already checked against live U.S. federal trademark filings (for similar products and overall) plus the .com and .co. Use when the user wants name ideas and does not have a list yet. Returns facts only (what is on file), never a legal opinion; ideas are starting points, not a clearance.

about.description: What the brand sells or does, in a few words, e.g. "small-batch soy candles".

category.description: Product category, if clear. Guessed from "about" when left out.

include.description: A word the user wants in the name, if any.

vibe.description: Up to three styles for the names.

name: suggest_names
title: Suggest checked name ideas
